dwelling_habits.dwelling: Bays, channels, and nearshore blue water in social groups.
dwelling_habits.food: Fish and squid hunted with teamwork and echolocation.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Herding, mud-ring feeding, and clever local tricks.
dwelling_habits.mating: Calves stay with mothers for years learning dolphin school.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Pods chat with clicks and whistles — ocean gossip.

fun_facts: Each dolphin may have a unique whistle ‘name’ friends recognize.
They sleep with one eye open — half the brain naps at a time.
